name: Sukhothai
blurb: Visitors to Sukhothai can explore UNESCO World Heritage ruins, ancient temples, and cycling routes through the historical park. The destination offers local food experiences such as steamed fish with ginger and mushrooms as well as cooking classes.

positive: Amazing local food and dining options
Peaceful atmosphere around the historical ruins and ponds
Great cycling and self-drive exploration opportunities
